The epitope of Fab28 on the HIV-1 RT p51 subunit was determined from the crystal structure of Fab28 bound to the complex of HIV-1 RT p51/p66 dimer/dsDNA (19-mer/18-mer). Fab28 binds to the p51 palm subdomain and has no contacts with either the p66 subunit or the dsDNA. The HIV-1 RT p51 subunit contained the C280S mutation.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.8 angstroms

The epitope of Fab28 on the HIV-1 RT p51 subunit was determined from the crystal structure of Fab28 bound to the complex of HIV-1 RT p51/p66 dimer cross-linked to tenofovir terminated template primer DNA (27-mer/21-mer). Fab28 binds to the p51 palm subdomain and has no contacts with either the p66 subunit or the DNA. The HIV-1 RT p51 subunit contained the C280S mutation.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.1 angstroms

The epitope of Fab 28 on the HIV-1 RT p51 subunit was determined from the crystal structure of Fab 28 bound to the complex of HIV-1 RT p51/p66 dimer/dsDNA (19-mer/18-mer). Fab 28 binds to the p51 palm subdomain and has no contacts with either the p66 subunit or the dsDNA. The HIV-1 RT p66 subunit contained the M184I mutation in the polymerase active site. Both RT subunits contained the C280S mutation.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.5 angstroms

The epitope of Fab28 on the HIV-1 RT p51 subunit was determined from the crystal structure of Fab28 bound to the complex of HIV-1 RT p51/p66 heterodimer/dsDNA (27-mer/21-mer). Fab28 binds to the p51 palm subdomain and has no contacts with either the p66 subunit or the dsDNA. The HIV-1 RT p51 subunit contained the C280S mutation and was truncated at Q428 with an added His tag. The RT p66 (AZTr) subunit contained the five excision-mediated AZT resistance mutations M41L, D67N, K70R, T215Y and K219Q, along with C280S and Q258C.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.9 angstroms
